snippet.title: Log Riders | Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
#indiegame #coop #coopgaming #logriders

Join a fun adventure by rolling a log together! In this 2 player co-op platformer, become lumberjacks with your friend and keep your balance while moving forward on a log. Overcome obstacles by moving back and forth, reach the goal, and never give up.

Steam Link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4082750/Log_Riders/

Available on February 12.
